race.comment: BLACKBELT (5) earns top billing after a debut second over 1200m at Ballarat, beaten a head by Gamadale Paddy and respected near the top of an open market. Profiles nicely up in trip and is very well placed to go one better. BRUTAL TEMPO (2) is a danger. The run here looks poor on margin, yet he was slow away and held up, while the Horsham second prior was a solid piece of maiden form. Can bounce back. VIVID LEGEND (8) brings the unknown upside as a $400,000 yearling purchase, arrives off a close Flemington trial and has first-time blinkers for a stable that can prepare one to win on debut. Keep safe. SUBSCRIPTION (7) was unwanted on debut at Mornington but was only beaten two and a half lengths after racing wide, so he has enough scope to improve up to a more suitable trip.
